### Manual differential expression analysis

To uncover what genes are up- or downregulated based on different stratifications such as: age groups, race, vital status etc.

#### DEA stratified on vital status

We convert the condition (vital status) to a binary vector and then group the dataframe by gene_names, obtaining tibbles with paired expression values and vital status of the source per gene.

```{r}
augment_df |>
  select(gene_name, log2_tpm, vital_status) |> 
  mutate(vital_status = case_when(vital_status == "Dead" ~ 1,
                                  vital_status == "Alive" ~ 0)) |> 
  group_by(gene_name) |> 
  nest() |> 
  mutate(model_object = map(.x = data,
                            .f = ~ lm(formula = log2_tpm ~ vital_status,
                                      data = .x)))
```
